title: Accurate day/night-cycles Mod (B3MReload)
description: Advanced time control and calendar system for Minecraft 1.21.1. Control day/night cycle speed, track years and dates, with full Serene Seasons integration.
body:
# B3MReload

A Minecraft mod for NeoForge 1.21.1 that provides advanced time control and calendar system.

## Features

### Time Control
- **Adjustable Time Speed**: Control day/night cycle speed without affecting mob spawning, player actions, or crop growth
- **Time Multiplier**: Range from -20.0 to 72.0 (negative values speed up time, positive values slow it down)
- **System Time Sync**: Optional real-time synchronization

### Calendar System
- **Custom Calendar**: Track years starting from year 1000 with 365 days per year
- **Configurable Start Date**: Set custom starting date for new worlds
- **Day Tracking**: Monitor total days, current year, and day of year

### Serene Seasons Integration
- **Automatic Season Control**: Seasons change based on B3M calendar
- **Season Calculation**: 
  - Spring: Days 1-91 (0-25%)
  - Summer: Days 92-182 (25-50%)
  - Autumn: Days 183-273 (50-75%)
  - Winter: Days 274-365 (75-100%)
- **Sub-seasons**: Early, mid, and late phases for each season
